chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
In Jehovah
do I take refuge:How say ye to my soul,Flee as a bird to your mountain;

For, lo,
the wicked bend the bow,They make ready their arrow upon the string,That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;

If the
foundations be destroyed,What can the righteous do?

Jehovah is
in his holy temple;Jehovah, his throne is in heaven;His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

Jehovah trieth
the righteous;But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

Upon the
wicked he will rain snares;Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.

For Jehovah
is righteous; he loveth righteousness:The upright shall behold his face.
